topic.title: Quick Start Guide
topic.shortdesc: A high-level walk-through of suggested first steps when starting to use .

body.p: Follow the steps below to get up and running with in your first session:

li.p: Get the platform address - Ask your administrator for the URL of your instance. See Accessing for details.
Sign up for an account - If you do not yet have an account, go to the platform main page and create one. See Sign Up for instructions.
Log in - Enter your credentials on the platform main page to access your workspace. See Log In for details.
Check your profile settings - Click your user name in the top-right corner to open your profile. See the profile settings page for more information.

Explore the interface - Once logged in, familiarize yourself with the main areas of : Projects (available to users with the Author platform user role) and Review Tasks. See User Interface Overview for a description of the general layout.
Go to the Cloud main page - Open in your browser. See Accessing for details.
Set up or join an organization - Create a new organization or sign up to an existing one:
To create a new organization, see Create an Organization.
To join an existing organization, see Sign Up to an Organization.
Log in to your organization workspace - Select your organization from the main page and complete the log-in process. See Log in to an Organization for details.
Check your profile settings - Click your user name in the top-right corner to open your profile. See profile settings page for more information.
Explore the interface. Once logged in, familiarize yourself with the main areas of : projects and review tasks. See User Interface Overview for a description of the general layout.

p.note: The role assigned to you determines the things you can do in . See User Roles to understand the available platform user roles, organization roles, project roles, and review task roles, and the actions each role permits.
